reason_metric_learning: Training a projection head, triplet, or prototypical network requires labeled same-class pairs across different recordings. CISLR v1.5-a provides exactly one non-test recording per class. No such pairs exist outside the official test set.
reason_split: A class-aware support/query split requires at least two non-test videos per class. There are zero such classes in CISLR v1.5-a.
reason_loo: Every prototype is the unique member of its class, so a held-out prototype has no same-class gallery item. LOO retrieval accuracy is identically zero and carries no information.
